title: Dessy X releases another Highly anticipated song titled "Bargaining"
htmlContent:
Emerging American music star Dessy X is a multi-talented singer and songwriter who has taken out time to become perfect in her career. Dessy X has once again showcased her incredible talent with the release of her recent song, “Bargaining.”

Dessy X’s new project, “Bargaining,”  cements her as one of the premiers and well-respected talents out of America. Her unique approach to the vocals has an exceptional quality that makes you listen to every word with lyrics that match the music to perfection and helps push this record to the next level to make it a must-hear sound.
